There are four different Music Sheets, which all look the same:

  • Music Sheet (First Verse), dropped by Novices of the Cult.
  • Music Sheet (Second Verse), dropped by Acolytes of the Cult.
  • Music Sheet (Third Verse), dropped by Adepts of the Cult.
  • Music Sheet (Fourth Verse), dropped by Enlightened of the Cult.

In addition, Grandfather Tridian drops all four. Learn all four to get the achievement Chorister
